description:
About the company
 Our client is an investment firm.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build and extend an internal software platform used for tracking investments, reconciling financial figures and producing periodic investor reports. The work covers backend services, data models and React-based interfaces, with frequent direct input from the people who use the tools each day.
 What you'll do
 - Maintain and extend an in-house platform covering investment monitoring, valuation tracking, financial tracking and quarterly investor reporting across a large portfolio.
 - Create automated pipelines that use AI to replace manual entry of board materials, financial statements and company reporting.
 - Build tooling that detects and corrects mismatches when financial figures fail to reconcile.
 - Develop internal AI agents and tool integrations that let staff query portfolio and pipeline data using plain language.
 - Partner with investment, finance and investor relations staff, turning their feedback into product changes on a quarterly release schedule.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 5 or more years building and shipping production web applications, beyond entry level.
 - Hands-on engineering experience across backend services, relational data modeling and frontend interfaces.
 - Strong SQL skills and good judgment about how to structure messy, inconsistent data before building interfaces on top of it.
 - Prior work on software for private markets, investment or fund operations, such as cap tables, valuations, portfolio monitoring or investor reporting.
 - Built and shipped back-office products or features in that domain.
 - A track record of staying with employers long enough to see the results of engineering decisions.
 - Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning their observations into clear scope.
 - Self-directed, hands-on approach: this is a coding role, not primarily management, architecture or research.
 Bonus points
 - Background in an internal technology group at an investment firm, or in work for a company serving that industry.
 - Production experience with AWS, container services, continuous integration and monitoring.
 - Experience building LLM-based features in production, including retrieval, evaluation and agent tooling.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 250,000 per year
 Location and work model
 - Foster City, California, United States or San Francisco, California, United States
 - Hybrid, 1 to 3 days per week in office (Fridays in office)
 - Fully remote is open for senior engineers who can work independently
 - Full-time
